text:
Florida arrives with a 3-2 win in Chicago on Saturday and a 3-2-0 run over its last five, but without Brad Marchand and Aleksander Barkov. Carter Verhaeghe has taken Marchand's spot beside Sam Reinhart and Brady Tkachuk, and Lars Eller is up to 17:19 a night from 12:14. Winnipeg is winless in five (0-3-2) after Saturday's 2-1 loss to Montreal, and Josh Morrissey is out too, so Neal Pionk is up to 26:09 a night.

The chances favor Florida. At five on five the Panthers have taken 55% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) against 46% for the Jets, and Winnipeg's 47% share over its slide says the skid is partly earned. Florida's weak spot is penalties: 5.8 taken a game, with a power play producing 1.08 expected goals a game against a Winnipeg penalty kill allowing 0.66. In net, projected starters Akira Schmid (-1.8 goals saved above expected this season, meaning he has stopped fewer than the shots deserved) and Clay Stevenson (+0.2) are both short on experience; Stevenson did save 3.1 above expected in four games last year.

Kyle Connor is our top scorer at 45% to score, with Mark Scheifele at 35%. For Florida, Reinhart is 37% and Matthew Tkachuk 72% for a point. Our under-the-radar picks: Brady Tkachuk, a third-liner at about 15:42 a night with 4.8 expected goals in his last 10 games, and Cole Perfetti, whose line creates chances. Both are players to watch, not locks.
